raw_text: Osprey Farpoint 40 Travel Pack. The Farpoint 40 is the carry-on travel pack trusted by world travelers. Volume: 40 liters. Weight: 1.59 kg. Price: $185.00. Carry comfort is where the Farpoint earns its reputation: an injection-molded, ventilated AirScape back panel keeps air moving against your back, while the padded hipbelt and shoulder harness transfer load to your hips for all-day comfort. Load-lifter straps and an adjustable sternum strap with emergency whistle fine-tune the fit. The entire back panel and harness stow away behind a zippered rear flap for clean airline handling. Large panel-loading main compartment with internal compression straps; padded 15-inch laptop and tablet sleeve in a lockable compartment; dual front mesh pockets and dual compression straps. Lockable zipper sliders on the main compartment. Dimensions: 55 x 35 x 25 cm — sized as a maximum international carry-on; check strict budget-airline limits before you fly. Built with 450D recycled polyester, bluesign approved fabric. Backed by Osprey's All Mighty Guarantee: we will repair any damage or defect, for any reason, free of charge — any product, any era.
